scope: Read-only post-Slice14 review; frozen artifacts and model implementations unchanged
matching_definition: Exact same decision_id / PA boundary, not early-warning windows; 55 points are not 55 independent alerts
correctness_validation: Not established; observed manager choice is not a correctness label or causal counterfactual
rolling_windows: Strictly before decision, 24/72/168/336 hours; includes already observed current-game pitches

streak_issue.current_mapping_semantics: Streak before the previous closed session, not before the current appearance
streak_issue.candidate_mapping_semantics: Candidate streak reconstructed relative to the decision date
streak_issue.required_followup: Unify decision-time streak semantics across current/candidate options, document treatment of today/session date, preserve separate prior-session streak, version and rerun workload ablations before fatigue interpretation

validation_remaining: RP-only 72-hour workload and consecutive-appearance-day removal/addition ablations on identical cohorts
Consider separating prior-appearance workload from already observed current-game pitches
Warning deduplication/cooldown and predeclared early-warning matching windows
Slices15-18 and20 for overlap, policy robustness, final test and recommendation release

2024_organic_actual_continuation_signal_.scope: Actor-aligned Slice13 features joined to organic_pa_eligible; different denominator from all-observed streak-mapping audit

season_appearance_index_review.prior_observed_relief_scope: Cumulative observed closed relief history across seasons, not current-season appearance number
season_appearance_index_review.followup: Reconstruct player-ID chronological season entry count with annual reset and explicit total/RP counts; do not count resumed sessions as new appearances

role_specific_work_plan: 13.3 recent bullpen observation and season-use trajectories
13.4 population-first TTO/BF curves then individual decline risk
13.5 prior-PA swing/contact profiles, familiarity and archetype interactions
14.1 rerun fixed-half comparisons and supported replacement pools
14.2 alert deduplication and observed substitution matching

recent_bullpen_and_batter_sequence_plan.bullpen_observation: Separate 3/5-day windows from last1/3/5 completed appearances; retain Stuff/Location, physical and outcome support, personal same-type baseline, trend, n, timestamps and staleness; no recent observations does not mean normal state
recent_bullpen_and_batter_sequence_plan.batter_observation: Separate received pitch mix, swing rate by type and type share of all swings; measure whiff/contact/foul/fair-contact and supported batted-ball quality from strictly earlier PA only
recent_bullpen_and_batter_sequence_plan.observation_scopes: Next batter vs this pitcher; same-game other pitchers; older H2H/type history; lineup-wide recent PA; never silently mix scopes
recent_bullpen_and_batter_sequence_plan.familiarity_axes: Exact batter-pitcher prior encounters, pitches actually seen, lineup cycle when reconstructable, and cumulative BF are distinct; handle substitutes and zero-pitch IBB
recent_bullpen_and_batter_sequence_plan.decline_study: Population role curves first, then supported pitcher curves with partial pooling; adjust pitch count/opponent ability/mix and observation selection; report effect size/intervals and search multiplicity, allow no stable decline
recent_bullpen_and_batter_sequence_plan.interpretation: Observed swing behavior does not reveal psychological targeting; familiarity association does not establish causality; future-prediction increments must be validated separately

eight_factor_review.batter_matchup: Direct H2H, within-game familiarity and archetype/family outcomes require separate support and hierarchical backoff; prior pitch-choice forecasts do not validate damage probability
eight_factor_review.historical_decline: Conditional risk curve with censoring/selection flags, not a fixed pitch-count removal threshold or historical substitution endpoint
eight_factor_review.reliever_state: Recent 3/5-day workload forms pre-entry context; observed current-appearance state remains relevant after entry
eight_factor_review.missing_context: Inning, score, outs, bases, substitution legality, supported actual availability and later bullpen resource constraints
eight_factor_review.value_mapping: Joint calibrated PA outcome/transition probabilities under each option, then common-endpoint WE/RE; no independent multiplication or arbitrary weighted factor total
